samples: This module defines a small deadline helper library: it can parse task lines of the form title plus date, count working days between two dates, and filter tasks that fall within a given upcoming window. Its sample `main` function gets today’s date, checks three hardcoded tasks, and prints the ones due in the next ten days along with how many weekdays remain until each due date. It looks useful if you want simple date-based task filtering and weekday counting, but it is only a demo program with fixed sample tasks rather than a full task manager.

This program defines a small deadline utility that can parse task lines, count working days between two dates, and filter tasks due within a chosen window. Its sample `main` uses today’s date to print the tasks due in the next ten days, along with how many Monday-to-Friday days remain until each due date. It looks useful if you want simple date-based task filtering and reporting, but it only demonstrates fixed sample tasks rather than reading real input.

This program defines a small deadline utility that can parse task lines, count working days between two dates, and filter tasks due within a chosen window. Its sample `main` uses today’s date, checks a hardcoded list of tasks, and prints the ones due in the next ten days along with how many weekdays remain until each deadline. It’s useful if you want simple date-based task triage, but it only handles a narrow input format and does not include persistence, reminders, or holiday-aware business-day logic.

This program defines a small deadline utility that can parse task lines, filter tasks due within a chosen window, and count the working days remaining until each due date. Its sample `main` prints the tasks from a built-in list that are due in the next ten days, along with how many Monday-to-Friday days are left.
